text:
jane_cs: Quick sync for Newhaven private VPC cutover planned Fri. Compliance checklist: KMS cross-account for logs, egress path to our collector + S3 (they also want Splunk mirror), redaction policy for model inputs, and immutable retention (5y). Finance said renewal flagged if cutover causes >1hr outage. Any blockers?

owen_net: Networking: TGW attachment done. Recommend S3 gateway endpoint (vpce-0b2c3d4e) to avoid NAT. Need SG to allow outbound 443 to collector.redwood.internal and Splunk HEC host splunk.newhaven.corp:8088. Also confirm we publish route table ID in runbook.

liam_sre: I'll own the canary once SGs are in. Staging numbers: vpce + parallel uploader = median 23s to object available; NAT path adds ~14s. If they require <45s SLA we should push for VPCE.

nina_security: KMS: created alias/redwood/newhaven-logs (arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:555566667777:key/nh-1234). Proposed minimal key policy for their KMS team to add our logging role arn:aws:iam::888899990000:role/redwood-logging with Encrypt and GenerateDataKey only. We avoid cross-account Decrypt. Sample snippet for them to paste: 

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "AllowRedwoodLogging",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::888899990000:role/redwood-logging"},
      "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:555566667777:key/nh-1234",
      "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"kms:ViaService": "s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com"}}
    }
  ]
}
```

nina_security: Also sending our masking config: fields `prompt`, `user_input`, `raw_text` are hashed with SHA256 and PII regex scrub applied. Raw prompt export requires signed addendum.

simon_newhaven: Thanks. A couple clarifications: 1) can you provide a one-page flow (who holds Decrypt, rotation cadence), 2) auditors want proof of immutability for 5y (we use Object Lock). We'll need a short attestation template.

jane_cs: Good asks. @nina_security please publish the one-pager + attestation template. @owen_net add SG + route table to runbook. @liam_sre run canary after SGs. I'll mark renewal "on-watch" until Canary+KMS acceptance.

liam_sre: SG created: sg-0e4f5a6b, route table posted rtb-0f1e2d3c. Running canary: curl -i https://collector.redwood.com/health from Newhaven VPC -> HTTP/1.1 200 OK; PutObject -> object visible in Redwood S3 in 29s. Canary PASS. :white_check_mark:

auditbot: Staging dry-run: vpce + uploader = median 22s; Object Lock test PASS.

nina_security: Sent one-page flow + rotation cadence doc (Redwood envelope key rotate 30d; customer KMS rotate 90d suggested) and attestation template to simon_newhaven email. Waiting on policy acceptance.

simon_newhaven: Received docs. We'll apply the KMS snippet and reply when done. Two asks: can you scope the EncryptionContext to project=newhaven? We'll add that if possible.

nina_security: Yes we can add EncryptionContext condition. Updated snippet emailed.

simon_newhaven: Applied KMS policy with EncryptionContext project=newhaven. Running a quick canary now.

liam_sre: Confirmed PutObject -> collector acknowledged; object available and retrievable in 31s. KMS cross-account acceptance logged.

jane_cs: Excellent. Moving renewal from "on-watch" -> "monitor" pending signed attestation. Closing when attestation returns signed. Thanks team :thumbsup:

auditbot: Retention-attestation reminder scheduled: 2026-09-01T09:00:00Z.
